says: One light for the whole page now, from the upper left: the wall face turns toward it, the drop face of the ledge goes to a mid tone, and all shadows fall down and right. The wall is cut by recursive irregular splits into slabs of wildly different sizes, with jagged edges; most faces stay white, flat undersides go dark, and a thin overhang shadow sits under each top edge. The strider gets mass: a heavy body with curved form lines that the rider overlaps, thick tapering thighs and a thick neck drawn as closed contours with cross-contour rings. The far wall now stops at the head, whose contour is firmer and whose face side, away from the light, is hatched and stippled.
